subject.title: feat(ui): finish the chat session → thread rename across the Control UI

question: Should the user-facing rename include the explicitly flagged worktree, lifecycle-state, durable-channel fallback, and external Codex/Claude catalog strings, or should any of those retain “session”?
rationale: The branch is mechanically safe, but those strings describe adjacent concepts whose preferred product vocabulary cannot be determined from tests or the prior creation-surface rename alone.

options.title: Approve the full sweep
options.body: Use “thread” consistently for all listed user-facing chat-adjacent copy while retaining technical session identifiers.

options.title: Keep selected adjacent terms
options.body: Revert the identified worktree, lifecycle, durable-channel, or external-catalog strings where “session” better describes the underlying concept.

recommendation.title: Approve the full sweep
recommendation.body: Use “thread” consistently for all listed user-facing chat-adjacent copy while retaining technical session identifiers.
